concerns.text: FR-007 requires 'a hard threshold based on the static model's confidence', but neither FR-002 nor FR-007 defines what 'confidence' means for the chosen regressors (Random Forest or shallow MLP output point predictions, not confidences). Without a defined confidence quantity (e.g., prediction variance across trees, ensemble disagreement, or a calibrated interval) and a procedure for setting the threshold value, an implementer cannot know when FR-007 is met. Define the confidence measure and how the threshold is selected.

SC-005 measures CPU cost 'against the baseline GPU-bound dynamic heuristic to quantify efficiency gains', but the project is CPU-only (Assumptions) and no FR requires running the GPU-bound dynamic heuristic. The comparison reference is unreachable as specified. Revise to name a measurable reference, e.g. published/estimated cost of the ACE-Ego-0 dynamic pipeline, or restate as absolute CPU time/memory of the static pipeline measured against the CI runner budget.

'a defined threshold (e.g., <1% improvement per added second)' leaves the diminishing-returns threshold as an example rather than a defined value. Constitution Principle VII requires the project to 'define a specific threshold'. State the threshold (or the procedure that fixes it before the sweep runs) so the elbow-identification criterion is checkable.
